passage.text: Emma! I went to my first networking event last night.
passage.reading: ˈɛmə! aɪ ˈwɛnt tə maɪ ˈfɜːrst ˈnɛtwɜːrkɪŋ ɪˈvɛnt ˈlæst ˈnaɪt.

passage.text: You know I'm an introvert, so I almost stayed home.
passage.reading: juː ˈnoʊ aɪm ən ˈɪntrəvɜːrt, soʊ aɪ ˈɔːlmoʊst ˈsteɪd ˈhoʊm.

passage.text: But I decided to step out of my comfort zone.
passage.reading: bʌt aɪ dɪˈsaɪdɪd tə ˈstɛp ˈaʊt əv maɪ ˈkʌmfərt ˌzoʊn.

passage.text: Good for you! How was it?
passage.reading: ˈɡʊd fər juː! ˈhaʊ wʌz ɪt?

passage.text: Did you talk to anyone, or did you stand in a corner all night?
passage.reading: dɪd juː ˈtɔːk tu ˈɛniwʌn, ɔːr dɪd juː ˈstænd ɪn ə ˈkɔːrnər ˈɔːl ˈnaɪt?

passage.text: Ha! I talked to lots of people.
passage.reading: ˈhɑː! aɪ ˈtɔːkt tə ˈlɑːts əv ˈpiːpəl.

passage.text: First, I met Chris. He's a real extrovert, and he knows everyone.
passage.reading: ˈfɜːrst, aɪ ˈmɛt ˈkrɪs. hiːz ə ˈriːəl ˈɛkstrəvɜːrt, ənd hiː ˈnoʊz ˈɛvriwʌn.

passage.text: Then I met Hannah from Melbourne. Her Thai is better than mine!
passage.reading: ˈðɛn aɪ ˈmɛt ˈhænə frəm ˈmɛlbərn. hɜːr ˈtaɪ ɪz ˈbɛtər ðən ˈmaɪn!

passage.text: Hannah knows Mr. Brown! What a small world!
passage.reading: ˈhænə ˈnoʊz ˈmɪstər ˈbraʊn! ˈwʌt ə ˈsmɔːl ˈwɜːrld!

passage.text: I'm so proud of you. Introverts can be great at networking, because they're good listeners.
passage.reading: aɪm soʊ ˈpraʊd əv juː. ˈɪntrəvɜːrts kən bi ˈɡreɪt ət ˈnɛtwɜːrkɪŋ, bɪˈkɔːz ðɛr ˈɡʊd ˈlɪsənərz.

passage.text: Definitely! Hannah's friend runs a language school, and I'm meeting her next week.
passage.reading: ˈdɛfənətli! ˈhænəz ˈfrɛnd ˈrʌnz ə ˈlæŋɡwɪdʒ ˌskuːl, ənd aɪm ˈmiːtɪŋ hɜːr ˈnɛkst ˈwiːk.

passage.text: Stepping out of my comfort zone was the best decision I've made this year!
passage.reading: ˈstɛpɪŋ ˈaʊt əv maɪ ˈkʌmfərt ˌzoʊn wʌz ðə ˈbɛst dɪˈsɪʒən aɪv ˈmeɪd ðɪs ˈjɪr!
